payback.scope: Measured six-task evaluation totals plus actual calibration tasks and fitting caller time. Learning/startup/reopen shown separately; excludes any assigned value of useful calibration tasks. No unseen longer-horizon repayment claim.

deployment.scope: Accounting over actual fresh-owner launches and measured tasks. Charges seed learning to memory/calibrated, calibration to calibrated. Validation-only reopen/export/copy time excluded and separately reported. Prepared matched runs are not additional empty-project executions.

setup085.scope: Verified comparison tasks plus measured fitting; excludes learning, launch, copying and future model checks

coverage.scope: Coverage counts only. Execution still requires nearby tasks, the same receipt, proof state, saving workload and runtime, and the original outcome checks.

groups.reason: Repeat counts met; current receipt, task distance and original evidence still checked

summary.scope: One growing-bank sequence per control, six predeclared unseen scenes, real retention and skill saving, cold owner per goal. Descriptive single-machine timings; no probability, causal bank-cost or model-weight-training claim.
